1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de hasta 20 m de altura, de follaje denso y copa redondeada, hojas compuestas de folíolos ásperos al tacto, inflorescencia en racimos y flores grandes de color rojo anaranjado con el borde amarillento. Bignoniaceae, Spathodea campanulata.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree reaching heights of up to 20 m, with dense foliage and a rounded crown, compound leaves with rough-textured leaflets, inflorescence in racemes and large flowers of reddish-orange color with yellowish edges. Bignoniaceae, Spathodea campanulata.
